scope: True native-Windows local report export integration failure; minimal held-directory extended-path representation fix.

root_cause.before: descriptor_path returned a normal visible Windows path. The immutable .export_*.partial stage pushed a legitimate report destination beyond MAX_PATH. Path.mkdir/write raised native path-length OSError, caught as a generic report integrity failure.
root_cause.proof: All four report source hashes matched independent registered hashes in the synthetic actual verifier database. A separate real report-native-export regression then reproduced complete:false/zero copied report files before the patch. No integrity validator or receipt schema mismatch was found.

minimal_fix: descriptor_path first checks the live held Directory, preserves an existing extended prefix, maps drive paths to extended drive form and UNC paths to extended UNC form. Directory.path, handle ancestry, no-SHARE_DELETE protection, no-reparse NT relative operations and atomic publication are unchanged. No registry/environment configuration is required.
